title: Rivet Road

reference.name: Steel Boulevard
reference.study: Vehicle structure and coherent urban space; independent simple touch campaign.

skillsApplied.game-development: Fixed 60 Hz deterministic simulation, bounded effects and state machines.
skillsApplied.game-design: One-finger drive/stop-fire loop, four authored objectives, physical capability unlocks.
skillsApplied.game-art: One shared material palette and lighting rig across character, vehicle, objects and city. Separate tread, turret, recoil, crew and bridge animation.
skillsApplied.3d-games: Simple simulation colliders, instanced tracks, geometry batching, restrained shadow map and smooth following camera.
skillsApplied.web-games: Bundled renderer, local ES modules, explicit graphics failure UI, gesture-unlocked audio and interruption handling.
skillsApplied.mobile-games: Touch joystick, pointer cancellation, 44px controls, bounded DPR and optional Light graphics.
skillsApplied.game-audio: Synthesized engine, distinct shot/metal/break/rescue sounds and subdued musical pulse. No recorded reference audio.

limits: No physical handset benchmark or S-grade guarantee
